notes: Processed 42 groups from parts 36-40 into 41 rows. Merged groups 'idl' and 'international dance league' (same $15M Series A, Oct 21) into one row under group_key 'idl' with all four candidate ids. No round-up articles in these parts. Used 24 web lookups (budget 25): Prism Data (ffnews 404, fintech.global fetched), Prolific Machines (wsgr 403; search + pharmamanufacturing.com fetched + company homepage checked for AI claim, none found), Turba Labs (two searches + Fundz and Caplight fetched; sources disagree: Fundz/Dealroom say about $52M combined seed + Series A led by Creandum and Cusp Capital, Caplight says $40M Series A led by Creandum; recorded $52M per the hand-added title with confidence 0.6), Firstwork (techfundingnews fetched), Sante (AlleyWatch fetched), Sixiang (search only; FundedIQ gives $15M Series B, SpaceNexus says undisclosed; investors named only by databases so left empty), IDL (pulse2 fetched + HQ search: Los Angeles), BioConsortia (pulse2 fetched; investor is an entity affiliated with John Pasquesi, no series label), Edonia (search + tech.eu fetched), Meticulous (HQ search: press release datelined San Francisco, some outlets say London, so US per dual-HQ rule), Consano Bio (search: Burlington, MA), SecondSight (search: Series A closed Oct 5, amount undisclosed), 'facebook' group resolved via two searches to TrustedRouter ($6M seed led by Sierra Ventures, Semafor Oct 16), DashFuel (search: press coverage says San Francisco-based). For rows whose part-file text was null or wrong (Prism Data, Prolific Machines, Turba Labs, Firstwork, Sante, Edonia, TrustedRouter) the evidence spans are quoted from the fetched pages listed in source_urls, not from the part file, so the validator may not find them in the feed text. 'parallel loop' resolved URL points to an unrelated restaurant site, so source_urls is empty and the row is filled from the title only. 'sunmmio' is an aggregate of several rounds over a year with no single round identified. 'how much did fetch' is a Clay profile page, not funding news. Lucid Diagnostics and Medincell are public companies. October Capital is a PE firm launch (fund). Lippincott/Athletics and HCLSoftware/Robotiq.ai are acquisitions. Rhino USA, Everphone and Medincell are debt. Currency conversions: EUR at 1.08, CNY at 0.14, INR Rs 40 Cr at 84 per USD. HQ for Everphone (Berlin), BioConsortia (Davis, CA), ITpipes (Albuquerque, NM), Locus Lock (Austin, TX), HappyCo (San Francisco, CA), SecondSight (Indianapolis, IN) and Prism Data (New York, NY) come from prior knowledge, not the article text; Rising Tide and TrustedRouter are set to US by inference (US-focused market and US investors) with lowered confidence.
